leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Apply z-index values to position elements along the z-axis
Construct stacking contexts using CSS properties like position and opacity
Manipulate element stacking order by adjusting z-index values
Configure parent elements to create isolated stacking contexts
Integrate z-index with positioned elements to control visual hierarchy
Implement stacking context boundaries to manage overlapping content
Control element visibility through strategic stacking context creation
